wargear.name: Prospero sigil-charm
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tiny glyph-etched amulet, renewed every dawn by a cabal scribe. The model has a 5+ Invulnerable Save if it was worse.

wargear.name: Fate-glass
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A lens of cut crystal through which a sorcerer glimpses a few seconds of the next minute. The model gains +1 Willpower and +1 Intelligence.

wargear.name: Warp-touched banner
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A standard whose threads shift colour when no one is looking. Every model in the unit gains +1 Willpower and +1 Intelligence.

wargear.name: Warding-sigil engraving
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Rune-lines cut into the hull by a Prosperine artisan. The model has a 4+ Invulnerable Save if it was worse.

option.text: The Sergeant may take a Prospero weapon
The Sergeant may wear a Prospero sigil-charm
The unit may carry a Warp-touched banner
Up to five Pink Horrors may exchange their coruscating grasp for
May be etched with Warding sigils

rules.name: Warp Rift Arrival
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Host of Change). A unit with this rule gains Deep Strike. It may appear from the warp anywhere more than 9" from enemy units.

rules.name: Cabal Bladework
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Khenetai Ascendant). A unit with this rule adds Rending (6+) to all of its melee attacks.

rules.name: Foresight
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Scrying Cabal). After both armies are deployed and before the first turn, each unit with this rule may make one free Set-up Move of up to 6".

rites.name: Host of Change
rites.flavor: The Cabal stopped asking what the Changer of Ways wanted, and began to give it room.
benefits: Flamers and Screamers of Tzeench may fill Troops slots.
Horrors, Flamers and Screamers of Tzeench gain Warp Rift Arrival: Deep Strike.
limitations: At least one Horrors of Tzeench unit must start the battle in Reserve.
At least two Horror Squads and one Herald of Tzeench or Prosperine Sorcerer are required.
No Tactical, Despoiler, Breacher or Assault Squads.

modifiers.text: Host of Change: Warp Rift Arrival.

require.note: Bring at least two Horrors of Tzeench.
A Herald or Prosperine Sorcerer must lead the host.

rites.name: Khenetai Ascendant
rites.flavor: The blade-cabal is where the Legion keeps its pride, and a Legion's pride is rarely kept quiet.
benefits: Khenetai Occult Cabals and Sekhmet Terminator Cabals may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Cabal Bladework: Rending (6+) on all their melee attacks.
limitations: At least two Khenetai Occult Cabals are required.
No Armour units and no Support units other than Apothecaries and Techmarines.

require.note: Bring at least two Khenetai Occult Cabals.

rites.name: The Scrying Cabal
rites.flavor: The Legion that has foreseen the battle does not need the biggest guns, only the best-placed.
benefits: Numerologist Cabals and Ammitara Occult Intercession Cabals may fill Troops slots.
They gain Foresight: after deployment and before the first turn, each may make a free 6" Set-up Move.
Every Thousand Sons Infantry unit gains +1 Willpower.
limitations: Every Thousand Sons Infantry unit loses 1 Move.
A Prosperine Sorcerer, Ahzek Ahriman or Magistus Amon must be in the army.
No Armour, Heavy Transport or Lord of War units.

require.note: A Prosperine Sorcerer, Ahriman or Amon must read the omens.
